name: Withings
description: Withings lets agents read the user's weight, body composition, blood pressure, sleep, and activity data, and log measurements after the user approves. It needs an active Withings+ membership, and each user signs in to their own Withings account through the browser.

prompts.text: How has my weight changed over the last three months?
Summarize my blood pressure readings from the last month for my doctor.
Did I sleep better on days when I walked more than 8,000 steps?

apps.name: Withings
apps.description: Weight, blood pressure, sleep, and activity data, over Withings's MCP server with browser sign-in.
